comment: A Monk in debug mode wishes for and wears her quest artifact, the Eyes of the Overworld, then creates a hostile player-monster cleric. When it casts the clerical blindness spell, Blinded is false because the Eyes block blindness, so mcast_blind_you() blinds the hero; Blind stays false, so 'Your vision quickly clears.' prints (mcastu.c:739-740). The hero's deaths are refused at the debug-mode Die? prompt.
